sections.title: Expected goals pipeline
paragraphs: The engine splits attack into finishing and chance-creation channels (xA / xG-buildup / xG-chain credit all outfield positions), then applies opponent suppression (back line 54%, mid shield 32%, GK 14%) and midfield battle modifiers.
Team A raw attack xG: 2.24 finishing + 0.18 creation = 2.42 before suppression. When Team B defends, suppression factor is 0.848 (DEF 0.45, mid-def 0.32, GK 0.67, transition risk 0.35).
Team B raw attack xG: 2.16 + 0.16 = 2.33. Team A suppression when defending: 0.834 (transition risk 0.20).
Midfield battle multipliers: Team A ×1.002, Team B ×0.998. Net xG edge: Team B by 0.09.

paragraphs: Team A xGA suppression: 0.747 (base without transition penalty: 0.839). Team B: 0.738 (base 0.816).

Team B fullbacks: Achraf Hakimi (RB, exposure 0.33), Nuno Mendes (LB, exposure 0.25). Team transition risk 0.353 — high attacking fullbacks increase counter vulnerability when midfield cover is thin.
